post_title: LF AI Open Model Initiative Phase II, Microsoft AI-RAN Founded — Open-Source AI Infra Accelerates

sections.title: [LF AI & Data Open Model Initiative Enters Phase II — Strengthening Governance and Accelerating Multimodal AI Development]
sections.lead: LF AI & Data under the Linux Foundation transitions the Open Model Initiative to Phase II, enhancing community-led initiatives for evaluation, benchmarking, and model development.[1][2]

sections.title: [LF Edge EdgeLake Project Promoted to Stage 2 — Standardizing Real-Time AI Inference at the Edge]
sections.lead: LF Edge's EdgeLake project advances to Stage 2, introducing the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to support real-time AI inference at the edge.[2]

sections.title: [Microsoft AI-RAN Alliance Founded — Advancing AI-Native Telecom Networks]
sections.lead: Microsoft joins as a founding member of the AI-RAN Alliance, promoting the integration of AI and RAN to intelligentize 5G/6G networks.
